newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi Q3 shr falls to $0.09 with charges.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi Q3 shr falls to $0.09 with charges.

text.p: ($ in millions except per share amounts, unaudited)
First Call earnings estimate for the quarter was $0.31 per share.
(a) One-time charges of $390 ($376 after-tax or $0.23 per share) associated with the international beverage operation.

(b) Included $22 net gain ($13 after-tax or $0.01 per share) in 1996 from sales of restaurants, including initial franchise fees, in excess of the costs of closing other restaurants and $3 in 1995 from store closure costs.

(c) Included benefit of $13 ($7 after-tax or $0.01 per share) in 1996 from lower depreciation and amortization expense resulting from the reduced carrying amount of certain long-lived assets due to the initial adoption of SFAS 121 as of the beginning of the fourth quarter of 1995.

(d) The reported effective tax rates were 67.4 percent in 1996 and 31.5 percent in 1995. Excluding the international beverage one-time impairment charges, the 1996 effective tax rate was 37.8 percent.
* Where percent changes are not meaningful, dollar changes are presented.
(a) same as footnote (a) for third quarter.

(b) Included a net gain of $60 ($35 after-tax or $0.02 per share) and $1 in 1996 and 1995, respectively, from sales of restaurants, including initial franchise fees, in excess of the costs of closing other restaurants and, in 1996, a charge for impairment of long-lived restaurants assets as a result of the first year application of SFAS 121.

(c) Included a benefit of $46 ($29 after-tax or $0.02 per share) in 1996 from lower depreciation and amortization expense resulting from the reduced carrying amount of certain long-lived assets due to the initial adoption of SFAS 121 as of the beginning of the fourth quarter of 1995.

(d) The reported effective tax rates were 41.0 percent in 1996 and 33.2 percent in 1995. Excluding the international beverage one-time impairment charges, the 1996 effective tax rate was 34.7 percent.
